Chapter 2 appears twice: a summary under 1.2 (page 11) and the full section (page 68); both are extracted as separate items. All Chapter 2 claims extracted; elsewhere only passages meeting the materiality test, with doubtful cases flagged theme_doubtful. Period covered taken from footnote 1 of the report (1 September 2024 to 1 September 2025) because the register field is empty. Text-file page numbers are printed page numbers plus one. Media content of Chapter 10 and freedom of expression (media regulator, public broadcaster, online media register) was treated as outside the technology theme, except net neutrality. Revised on 29 October 2026 under extraction rules 0.2 and themes 1.1: the narrower materiality test removed sector IT tools and digital skills items, eu_scale.applies_to was added, statuses and types were corrected, and two claims crossing page breaks were restored as new items -0203 and -0204; item IDs of kept items are unchanged. Second revision on 29 October 2026 under extraction rules 0.3 and themes 1.2: online services used by citizens or businesses (e-procurement, eHealth, industrial property and customs e-services) were restored with their 0.1b IDs, the Chapter 2 Employment Agency anti-corruption item was restored, and the seasonal-worker agreements item was removed as concerning nationals' access to EU labour markets. G3 independent review applied routine fixes (see review/RUN-2026-01/g3_qa/). Finalised on 29 October 2026 under extraction rules 0.4 and themes 1.3: the Public Revenue Office digital transition programme item (-0152) was removed under R22 as a tax IT upgrade, -0097 and -0130 were set to 'adopted' under R23, and the cybercrime, intelligent transport, digital finance, customs IT and tax IT misses from the G3 review were not added (R21, R22).
